notes: This contract pins the bounded embedded IEEE 1516.1-2025 federation synchronization-point implementation to the exact C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies official signatures, exception sets, callback symbols, and real Catch2 scenarios. Focused filesystem lanes connect the two C++ registration-result callbacks to the one §4.15 HLA service report and independently cover recipient-side §4.16 and §4.18 records without claiming a public MOM-interaction implementation. It is not catalog evidence, protected-review evidence, package support, or a conformance claim.
